description.value: Tacofino Ocho is the Vancouver outpost of the beloved BC-born Tacofino chain, which grew from a humble Tofino food truck into a regional institution known for Mexican-inspired west coast cooking. Situated in the Mount Pleasant neighbourhood at the corner of East 5th and Main, it makes a natural stop on one of Vancouver's busiest cycling corridors. Cyclists can order at the counter or pick up online orders, and delivery-app pickup options are also available.
